title: Add generated PWA and Android TWA icon/splash assets

requirements.summary: Add generated PWA app icon PNG assets under frontend/public/assets/generated/ matching manifest/favicon filenames.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_192x192.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/manifest.json` continues to reference `/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png` and the files load successfully in the browser.

file_operations.description: Add the generated 192x192 PNG app icon at `frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_192x192.png` so existing manifest references resolve to a valid image.
Add the generated 512x512 PNG app icon at `frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png` so existing manifest/favicon references resolve to a valid image.

requirements.summary: Add generated Android TWA adaptive icon foreground/background and splash PNG assets under frontend/public/assets/generated/ per frontend/android/README.md.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/assets/generated/android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.

file_operations.description: Add the generated Android adaptive icon foreground PNG at `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png` (432x432) for use by the Android TWA wrapper resource replacement step.

Add the generated Android adaptive icon background PNG at `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png` (432x432) for use by the Android TWA wrapper resource replacement step.
Add the generated Android splash PNG at `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png` (2732x2732) for use by the Android TWA wrapper resource replacement step.

requirements.summary: Update Android TWA wrapper drawable PNG resources to use the generated icon/splash assets so launcher icon and splash screen render correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: After updating resources, the Android project has `frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.png`, `ic_launcher_background.png`, and `splash_image.png` present as valid PNGs.
The launcher icon continues to reference the adaptive icon defined in `frontend/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml` and renders without missing-resource errors.

The splash screen continues to reference `@drawable/splash_image` (as configured in `frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawable/splash_screen.xml` and `AndroidManifest.xml`) and renders without missing-resource errors.

file_operations.description: Create/replace Android drawable `ic_launcher_foreground.png` by copying from `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png` as documented in `frontend/android/README.md`.
Create/replace Android drawable `ic_launcher_background.png` by copying from `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png` as documented in `frontend/android/README.md`.
Create/replace Android drawable `splash_image.png` by copying from `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png` as documented in `frontend/android/README.md`.
